name: drawio-workflow-skill
description: Zero-dependency Node.js (.mjs) agent skill for generating horizontal/vertical swimlane workflow diagrams (.drawio + .drawio.png) visualizing UI, Backend, and Storage (RDS/S3/DynamoDB/SQS) behavior

scripts.demo: node scripts/build-workflow.mjs --spec examples/order-checkout-workflow.json --direction horizontal --output examples/output/order-checkout-workflow.drawio.png && node scripts/build-workflow.mjs --spec examples/order-checkout-workflow.json --direction vertical --output examples/output/order-checkout-workflow-vertical.drawio.png
